mapper.sql: select menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, `query`, route_name, is_frame, platform_type,rich_text, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, ifnull(perms,'') as perms, icon, create_time from sys_menu
mapper.select:
SELECT sm.menu_id, sm.menu_name, sm.parent_id, sm.order_num, sm.path, sm.component, sm.`query`, sm.route_name, sm.is_frame, sm.platform_type, sm.rich_text, sm.is_cache, sm.menu_type, sm.visible, sm.status, IFNULL(sm.perms, '') AS perms, sm.icon, sm.create_time, cc.column_id, cc.column_name, cc.column_code, cc.column_type, cf.file_name, cf.file_url, cf.file_type FROM sys_menu sm LEFT JOIN content_column cc ON cc.menu_id = sm.menu_id AND cc.del_flag = '0' AND cc.`status` = '0' LEFT JOIN content_file cf ON cf.column_id = cc.column_id AND cc.column_type = 4 AND cf.del_flag = '0' AND cf.`status` = '0'
AND sm.status = '0' AND sm.visible = '0'
AND sm.status = #{status}
AND sm.platform_type != 'admin'
AND sm.platform_type = 'admin'
AND sm.menu_name like concat('%', #{menuName}, '%')
AND sm.visible = #{visible}
order by sm.platform_type,sm.parent_id, sm.order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time,m.platform_type,m.rich_text from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.visible, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time,m.platform_type,m.rich_text from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.role_id left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.status = 0 AND ro.status = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where m.status = '0' and r.status = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId}
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where m.status = '0' and rm.role_id = #{roleId}
select count(1) from sys_menu where parent_id = #{menuId}
where platform_type = #{platformType} AND menu_name=#{menuName} and parent_id = #{parentId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu( menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, order_num, path, component, `query`, route_name, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, remark, create_by, platform_type, rich_text, create_time )values( #{menuId}, #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{orderNum}, #{path}, #{component}, #{query}, #{routeName}, #{isFrame}, #{isCache}, #{menuType}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{platformType}, #{richText}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT cc.column_id AS columnId, cc.column_type AS columnType, sm.menu_name AS menuName FROM content_column cc INNER JOIN sys_menu sm ON sm.menu_id = cc.menu_id WHERE cc.menu_id = #{menuId} AND cc.del_flag = '0' AND cc.status = '0' AND sm.status = '0' AND sm.visible = '0' AND sm.platform_type != 'admin' LIMIT 1

SELECT cd.detail_id AS detailId, cd.detail_title AS detailTitle, cd.detail_content AS detailContent, cd.detail_image AS detailImage, cd.order_num AS orderNum FROM content_detail cd INNER JOIN content_column cc ON cc.column_id = cd.column_id INNER JOIN sys_menu sm ON sm.menu_id = cc.menu_id WHERE cd.column_id = #{columnId} AND cd.del_flag = '0' AND cc.del_flag = '0' AND cc.status = '0' AND cc.column_type IN ('1', '3') AND sm.status = '0' AND sm.visible = '0' AND sm.platform_type != 'admin' ORDER BY cd.order_num

SELECT cf.file_id AS fileId, cf.file_name AS fileName, cf.file_url AS fileUrl, cf.file_type AS fileType, cf.order_num AS orderNum FROM content_file cf INNER JOIN content_column cc ON cc.column_id = cf.column_id INNER JOIN sys_menu sm ON sm.menu_id = cc.menu_id WHERE cf.column_id = #{columnId} AND cf.del_flag = '0' AND cf.status = '0' AND cc.del_flag = '0' AND cc.status = '0' AND cc.column_type IN ('2', '4') AND sm.status = '0' AND sm.visible = '0' AND sm.platform_type != 'admin' ORDER BY cf.order_num

SELECT cd.detail_content AS detailContent, cd.detail_image AS detailImage FROM content_detail cd INNER JOIN content_column cc ON cc.column_id = cd.column_id INNER JOIN sys_menu sm ON sm.menu_id = cc.menu_id WHERE cd.detail_id = #{detailId} AND cd.del_flag = '0' AND cc.del_flag = '0' AND cc.status = '0' AND cc.column_type IN ('1', '3') AND sm.status = '0' AND sm.visible = '0' AND sm.platform_type != 'admin'
